name: Pet The Dog
source:
Pet The Dog is a very short visual novel where you meet a rather unusual dog. Do you dare to pet it?

[From [url=https://hazumirein.itch.io/pet-the-dog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《宠物狗》是一部非常短的视觉小说，你在其中遇到了一只相当不寻常的狗。你还敢抚摸它吗？

[来自[url=https://hazumirein.itch.io/pet-the-dog]itch.io[/url]]
